title: Agentic AI production acceptance
source_policy: Repository-owned gates are PASS only when backed by merged dependency source and exact-head required CI. Real production/cPanel facts remain EXTERNAL_REQUIRED and must never be invented.

gates.requirement: All declared dependencies are integrated into main with their required CI/evaluation/security gates green.
evidence: FOODEX Required CI Gate and Repository Policy on the exact #2232 candidate head

gates.requirement: Wholesale owner receives deterministic sell-in intelligence, multi-tool analysis, evidence/freshness, RAG and governed actions within authorized scope.
Retailer manager sees only authorized retail facts; sell-out sharing is explicit, revocable and never inferred from wholesale sell-in.
Platform admin can operate provider/model health, redacted traces, kill switches and diagnostics without receiving secrets or unnecessary customer payloads.
Unauthorized, cross-store, cross-tenant and revoked-consent requests fail closed before tool/action execution.
No model text executes a write. Draft, explicit approval, re-authorization, conflict/idempotency checks and audit govern every supported action.
OpenAI-compatible/Ollama behavior is exercised through the real FOODEX provider gateway, including outage, malformed response, circuit/recovery and deterministic fallback.
Prompt injection, malicious RAG, secret exfiltration, tool abuse, cohort privacy and tenant isolation regressions pass on the integrated source.
Documented load/concurrency/cache/queue/cancellation/degraded-mode targets pass without one tenant exhausting provider capacity.
Production-like install/upgrade migrations and backfills complete safely using repository deployment acceptance.
evidence: FOODEX Required CI Gate: Backend validation / MySQL Redis deployment acceptance

gates.requirement: Core FOODEX commerce remains functional with Assistant and provider disabled.
Global Assistant, provider, tools and write-action kill switches have an operator-tested recovery path that does not require destructive database rollback.
Trace, provider/tool latency, failures, fallback, retention and export evidence is redacted and role-scoped.
Pilot activation uses feature flags, named acceptance metrics and rollback thresholds, with no unresolved AI P0/P1 defect.
evidence: Final #2232 PR evidence comment records the open AI-PROGRAM issue reconciliation and exact-head CI

gates.requirement: If production deployment is explicitly authorized, the operator records real backup identifiers, deployed SHA, migration result, HTTPS smoke and activation/rollback decision outside fabricated repository evidence.
